entries.title: Crestline Rate Card MFN Pricing
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc must ensure its rates and commercial terms remain no less favorable than those offered by itself or its Affiliates to any other customer for substantially similar services.
entries.quote: Supplier represents and warrants that the rates, fees and other commercial terms offered to Crestline under this Agreement are and shall remain no less favorable than those offered by Supplier or its Affiliates to any other customer for substantially similar services during the Term.

relatedClauses.quote: "Affiliate" means any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a Party, where "control" means ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting interests of the entity or the power to direct its management.

entries.notes: Rates are fixed for the first 12 months. Thereafter, rates may be increased by up to 3% once per contract year upon 60 days' written notice.

entries.title: Crestline MFN Audit Rights
entries.summary: Crestline or an independent auditor may audit AtliQ Inc's records up to once per year upon reasonable notice to verify compliance with the MFN pricing terms.
entries.quote: Upon reasonable notice and no more than once per year, Crestline or an independent auditor bound by confidentiality may audit Supplier's records to verify compliance with this Section 6.

relatedClauses.quote: Supplier represents and warrants that the rates, fees and other commercial terms offered to Crestline under this Agreement are and shall remain no less favorable than those offered by Supplier or its Affiliates to any other customer for substantially similar services during the Term.

entries.notes: Limits audits verifying MFN compliance to once per year upon reasonable notice.

entries.title: Crestline Offshore Data Access Restriction
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc is prohibited from accessing Crestline production data from outside the United States without prior written approval.
entries.quote: Supplier shall not access Crestline production data from outside the United States without Crestline's prior written approval.
entries.notes: Prevents offshore resources from accessing production data without written consent.

entries.title: Crestline Security Incident Notification
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc must notify Crestline within 72 hours of becoming aware of any security incident affecting Crestline data.
entries.quote: Supplier shall notify Crestline within seventy-two (72) hours of becoming aware of any security incident affecting Crestline data.
entries.notes: Standard security incident notification window is 72 hours.

entries.title: Crestline Insurance Requirements
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc must maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least $1,000,000, professional liability/E&O of at least $2,000,000, and statutory workers' compensation insurance.
entries.quote: Supplier shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least $1,000,000 per occurrence, professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least $2,000,000, and workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
entries.notes: Requires typical commercial general, professional liability, and workers' compensation insurance policies.

entries.title: Crestline Vendor Data Security & Privacy Compliance
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc must comply with Crestline's Vendor Data Security Requirements and all applicable US federal and state privacy laws, including the Ohio Data Protection Act.
entries.quote: Supplier shall comply with Crestline's Vendor Data Security Requirements, as updated from time to time, and all applicable U.S. federal and state privacy laws, including the Ohio Data Protection Act where applicable.
entries.notes: Binds AtliQ Inc to an external Vendor Data Security document which may be unilaterally updated by Crestline, and requires compliance with the Ohio Data Protection Act.

referencedButMissing.note: Mentioned in Section 13.1 as a set of security requirements the Supplier must comply with, but not attached to the agreement.

referencedButMissing.note: Mentioned in Section 5.4 as the policy governing reimbursable travel expenses, but not attached to the agreement.
